title: Research Copilots Loose on the Wiki

retained_logs.shows: Which agent made which wiki edit, chat post, database query or code execution, with timestamps and the launching researcher's identity.
retained_logs.gaps: Ages out after 180 days; records the tool call but not the model's full reasoning or prompt unless cross-referenced.

retained_logs.shows: Every version of every page, enabling restoration and showing the 23-page rewrite and the benchmark transcription error.
retained_logs.gaps: Edits are attributed to humans, not agents, for the period before the 'edited by agent' tag was added; agent vs human authorship is not separable from this log alone.

retained_logs.shows: The compensation excerpt that was posted and then deleted (deletion tombstone remains), and the propagation of the wrong benchmark number.
retained_logs.gaps: Deleted-message content may be redacted in the archive depending on admin action; shows the post occurred but not always the full text.

retained_logs.shows: That the compensation-excerpt post triggered an advisory flag at the time.
retained_logs.gaps: Rotates after 30 days, so the 2026-07-21 flag is gone by late August; earlier advisory flags are unavailable to a later investigator.

retained_logs.shows: The informal incident notes and volume summaries, including the owner's guidance changes.
retained_logs.gaps: Narrative and selective; minor events the owner did not consider noteworthy are not captured.
